comparison.objective: Clear a lane and push a block to a dock; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Obstacle clearing and planar pushing versus bimanual small-part stabilization, key use and fine adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Lane clear and block docked versus two physically simulated stops within dynamic and retention limits.
comparison.reason: Navigation-like rearrangement does not test an adjustable retained mechanism. Body, specs and tolerances are missing.
